have : ∃ n, t n < x ∧ x ≤ t (n + 1) :=
  by {
    let u := t
    have h_mono : StrictMono u := ht_mono
    have h_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := ht_tendsto
    have h_not_mem : x ∉ {t n | n : ℕ} :=
      by contrapose! hx; intro hmem; cases hmem with n; exact le_antisymm (t n) x
    have h_nonempty : {t n | n : ℕ}.Nonempty :=
      by exists 0; exact le_refl (t 0)
    have h_lub : IsLUB {t n | n : ℕ} x :=
      by {
        refine ⟨λ y h, _, λ h, _⟩
        · intro h; rcases h with ⟨n, hn⟩; exact lt_iff_le_not_le.1 (le_of_lt hn)
        · exact hx
      }
    apply IsLUB.exists_seq_strictMono_tendsto_of_notMem
    exact h_lub
    exact h_not_mem
    exact h_nonempty
  }
